Key Traffic Advisory (Quick Facts)
•Date: February 17, 2026

•All vehicles Restricted 
From 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM

•Day long 13 hour Complete prohibition on Heavy Motor Vehicles (HMVs)

•Affected Stretch: Western Express Highway
•From Vakola Flyover to Dahisar Toll Naka
•Both northbound & southbound carriageways
